name: Keswick–North York / earlier Newmarket Highway 404
description: The current route family connects the Keswick/Highway 404 corridor with Finch. An earlier Table 67 describes Newmarket Highway 404 service; it should not be mistaken for evidence of a Keswick route in 2003.

timeline.event: Table 67 is titled Newmarket Highway 404, running from Newmarket via Aurora and Highway 404 to Finch.
First weekday operation of the new Keswick–Finch service from Glenwoods Park & Ride, via Aurora Carpool and Yonge/Sheppard.
The original schedule shows the Woodbine/404, Queensville/404, Davis/404, Wellington/404 and Major Mackenzie/404 park-and-ride chain.
The Keswick–Finch corridor is documented in the September timetable.

gaps: Exact transition dates between the original Newmarket Table 67 and the later Keswick route, and dates of each Highway 404 park-and-ride addition, remain to be established.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
